dedupe_keys.name: siemens building x cloud building operations platform

description: Building X is a Siemens platform that runs applications for managing building operations on a central, secure, cloud-based foundation of real-time data. Its applications cover energy and sustainability, safety and security, and operations and maintenance, with AI and machine learning for real-time analytics and forecasting, customisable visualisations and reports, and a set of open APIs for application data access, building data management and user accounts. Siemens stresses IT and OT integration across all building systems, onboarding data once for use across domains, a partner ecosystem under Siemens Xcelerator, and UL Solutions Smart System Verified Platinum status for connectivity, cybersecurity and interoperability; it reports customers achieving up to 30% energy savings and up to 10% more net operating income. Siemens press material found by search describes it as open, vendor agnostic and built on Siemens Xcelerator, consolidating data into a digital building operations twin (secondary to the product page). Coverage: generic; buildings connected through Siemens or third-party systems. Access: consultation or guided tour through Siemens. Licence: commercial. Caveats: savings figures are the vendor's claims, and no prices were published. Simulation uses: operational building twins supplying live energy, comfort and fault data. Related records: Willow, Azure Digital Twins and Brick Schema.
